name: Deep learning methods for clinical workflow phase-based prediction of procedure duration: a benchmark study.
description: A comparative benchmark study evaluating deep learning approaches for predicting procedure duration based on clinical workflow phases.
evaluation_method: regression metrics (mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE); sometimes MAPE)
reputation: A useful comparative study for clinical workflow duration prediction within specialized surgical/clinical ML research communities but not a widely adopted public benchmark.
notes: Clinical-domain, non-LLM benchmark; results are dataset- and procedure-dependent, subject to limited data size, institutional biases, and privacy-driven data heterogeneity which can limit generalization.
